name: astro-flow
description: Astros — mapa natal, transitos e horoscopo calculados em tempo real

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @astros/contracts && npm run build --workspace @astros/astro-core && npm run build --workspace @astros/api && npm run build --workspace @astros/web && npm run build --workspace trinta-graus
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run build --workspace @astros/contracts && npm run build --workspace @astros/astro-core && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
